page.overview:
Who is Ange?

Ange is a giant from Elbaph. She works as a language teacher at the Walrus School, as an assistant for Jaguar D. Saul and as a librarian of the Owl Library.

Ange is a giant woman of stocky build and just slightly taller than Gerd. She sports freckles, a turned-up nose, wide chin and dark hair arranged in multiple braids.

Her ensemble includes a frilly shirt, a short fur skirt and a hooded cloak. She sports thick glasses and wears a over her head.

Unlike most giants, Ange is polite and knowledgeable. She is dutiful to her superior Saul, enough to humor and engage herself in his more eccentric whims. She appears to have supported Harald and his reforms for the country, and seemed to be saddened by his death. This is further supported by her speech to the God's Knights about her belief that the Walrus School and Owl Library were more important than anything else on Elbaph.
